scope: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL; actual Medusa native refund workflow, Query/Link, payment/order modules, unregistered candidate adapter and local event bus; provider dispatch and Stripe GET responses are fixtures; no real Stripe HTTP or production provider change
checks: actual Query resolves the actual native order/payment Link created through the installed Link API
a mismatching native callback is rejected before provider reads; the failed native workflow cleans up its refund and leaves no debit
initial candidate calls the installed refundPaymentWorkflow and the unregistered provider adapter with an actual Medusa cradle, creating exactly one correctly associated refund and negative USD debit
repeated bookkeeping reuses the native refund and debit without another provider callback or funds POST
